docs.summary: Registration contract for a mesh feature. Describes how to generate one and how its settings slot into the mesh/model importer settings blob.
docs.remarks: A concrete [`MeshFeatureSpec`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.MeshFeatures.MeshFeatureSpec) subclass is discovered via reflection by [`MeshFeatureRegistry`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.MeshFeatures.MeshFeatureRegistry) and instantiated once. Bumping [`Version`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.MeshFeatures.MeshFeatureSpec~Version) causes every mesh importer to reimport (cache invalidation rides on the aggregate version exposed by [`AggregateVersion`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.MeshFeatures.MeshFeatureRegistry~AggregateVersion)).

docs.summary: Short stable key (e.g. "sdf"). Used for sub-asset naming and settings keys.
Human-readable name shown in inspector UI (e.g. "Signed Distance Field").
The runtime type produced by this feature.
Bump when generation logic changes forces reimport of all meshes.
Populate defaults under the given importer-settings compound. Implementations should write a nested compound at `settings[Key]` with their knobs (including an `enabled` flag, default false).

docs.summary: Read settings, decide whether to generate, and return the feature or null. Return null when disabled or when generation is skipped (no error). Called from worker threads.
